summary: In the sitting room, Morpheus rises from a couch as the priestess escorts Neo out. Once the priestess has left and Morpheus and Neo are alone, Morpheus puts his hand on Neo's shoulder and tells him he doesn't have to tell anyone what 'she' told him, because what was said was said for him alone. Neo nods and takes a bite of his cookie.

what_changes.before: Presumed unaware of what the Oracle privately told Neo.
what_changes.after: Acting as though he knows Neo received a private communication and offering to keep it secret.
what_changes.evidence: You don't have to tell anyone what she told you.  What was said was said for you and you alone.

what_changes.before: Just escorted out of the Oracle's presence, silent.
what_changes.after: Accepts Morpheus's reassurance, nodding and eating a cookie.
what_changes.evidence: Neo nods and takes a bite of his cookie.

event_hint.one_line: Morpheus privately reassures Neo that the Oracle's words are to stay between them.
